sources: President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, post on X/Facebook, Nov 7
fault_line: North Korean missiles hitting Kyiv days before talks -- is the sanctions regime dead, or is this the pressure that forces a deal? And: 4 of 36 intercepted -- who resupplies the Patriots?

sections.what_happened: [PRIMARY-SOURCE CLAIM -- the KN-23 attribution, preliminary] 'Technical assessments are ongoing at the sites hit by ballistic missiles. According to preliminary findings, at one of the key energy facilities that was damaged, the Russians used KN-23 missiles manufactured and supplied by North Korea,' Zelensky said on Nov 7. Forensic examinations are ongoing; this is not a final report. [VERIFIED FACT -- the barrage] Russia fired 36 ballistic missiles and 172 drones overnight Nov 6-7 at Kyiv and the surrounding region; Ukraine intercepted only 4 of the 36 ballistic missiles (11%). Energy facilities were hit 18 times in 24 hours (Energy Minister Shmyhal); five regions lost power (Dnipropetrovsk, Donetsk, Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Kharkiv); transmission from the Rivne and Khmelnytskyi nuclear plants was seriously damaged; Kyiv's Pivnichnyi (Northern) Bridge was hit; Kyiv's mayor called the energy situation 'extremely difficult', with heating and water disrupted. [ATTRIBUTED -- Russian side] Russia's Defence Ministry said it struck military-industrial, energy and transport targets in and around Kyiv; it did not mention the KN-23. [TOLL DISCREPANCY -- unresolved, do not merge] Killed: Al Jazeera 'at least two' vs Times Now (Nov 7) 'six killed, including a seven-year-old child'. Wounded: khabr 'at least six, including a child' vs mohintechbd 'at least nine'. Figures differ by source and reporting window.
sections.what_verified: KN-23 attribution is Zelensky's own preliminary finding (primary source, T1 STATE UA) carried by 5 further tiered families: AFP (T1), Al Jazeera (T2), Ukrinform (T2 STATE UA), Dawn (T3), Times of India (T3). Kyiv Post, WION and SANA also carry it but have NO declared tier in the registry -- reported with attribution only, excluded from the family count. The barrage facts are strongly supported across the same families plus the Ukrainian Energy Ministry and Kyiv's mayor.
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Defence Ministry statement does not mention the KN-23 and no independent forensic confirmation has been published. Ukraine's Defence Ministry said in April 2026 that the KN-23 had been used in earlier attacks -- the missile type is not new to the war; only the attribution to this strike is new. Zelensky's framing (strikes timed to pressure Kyiv before the Abu Dhabi talks) is his interpretation.
sections.why_matters: The number that tells the story: 4 of 36 intercepted -- Ukraine's shield is failing as winter arrives, and now the missiles raining on Kyiv are North Korean. Proven topic (NATO/Russia war warnings), hard counted numbers.
sections.context: Background: MISSED CATCH-UP (Zelensky statement Nov 7, first surfaced Ukrinform Nov 7 16:12+02:00 / Dawn Nov 8 06:02 ; missed by the 0600 and 0700 scans; KN-23 attribution has 0 hits in any Nov 8 scan) -- Zelensky: preliminary forensic findings say Russia used North Korean KN-23 ballistic missiles against a key Ukrainian energy facility in the Nov 7 overnight barrage; only 4 of 36 ballistic missiles intercepted
